log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side
Light Screen ended on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Dragapult Infiltrator ignores screens, Incineroar Fake Out disrupts Grimmsnarl, Kingambit Defiant punishes dual Intimidate with +2 Atk, Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice OHKOs Grimmsnarl through screens and threatens Mawile/Arcanine. Will-O-Wisp handles physical pressure. Serperior left behind: Leaf Storm only neutral into Empoleon who carries Ice Beam.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's revealed mons: Arcanine (Intimidate, Snarl, Will-O-Wisp, Sitrus Berry, Calm), Mawile (Intimidate, Passho Berry, Brick Break, Play Rough, Impish), Empoleon (Competitive, Chople Berry, Ice Beam, Calm), Grimmsnarl (Prankster, Light Clay, Light Screen, Reflect, Taunt, Protect, Impish). Slowbro (Regenerator, Leftovers) and Garchomp (Rough Skin, Expert Belt) not brought in Game 1 but available. Their strategy: dual Intimidate + Light Screen to mitigate damage, Empoleon as special wall. Dragapult's Infiltrator bypasses screens entirely. Kingambit's Defiant turns Intimidate into free +1-2 Atk. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice 2HKO's most and OHKOs Grimmsnarl. Beware Prankster Taunt on Gardevoir before Mega. Empoleon Competitive punishes Intimidate from Incineroar; avoid triggering it.

decisions.rationale: Lead Arcanine (Intimidate, Snarl 2x Dragapult, resists Fire) + Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens, immune to Dragon, resists Dark) to blunt Incineroar/Dragapult. Back Empoleon for Serperior switch (Ice Beam 2x, resists Grass) and Mawile as wall vs Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega. Avoids Mawile vs Incineroar per plan; Grimmsnarl reserved for Mega counters.
decisions.notebook: Opp G1 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Serperior (no Mega; Gardevoir/Samurott unseen). Tendencies: leads Incineroar + pivot (Dragapult U-turn or Kingambit Defiant); Incineroar pressures Fire-weak; Serperior Contrary LeafStorm +2 SpA outpaces/KOs Empoleon if stayed; Kingambit Defiant triggers on Snarl/Intimidate. G2 plan: lead Arcanine+Grimmsnarl (Intimidate + Prankster screens) vs Incineroar/Dragapult; back Empoleon (Ice Beam 2x, resists Grass) to switch on Serperior; Mawile back as wall vs Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega; avoid Mawile as Incineroar target. Keep Grimmsnarl for expected Mega Gardevoir/Samurott. If opp Mega appears, same core walls it.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3) outruns Prankster Light Screen (+1) and flinches Grimmsnarl, blocking screens this turn. Shadow Ball chips Arcanine for 30-57% with no drawback vs Draco Meteor's miss risk and SpA drop. Dragapult's Infiltrator ignores future screens; Snarl does only 23-35% back. Next turn Parting Shot pivot into Kingambit or Gardevoir-Mega depending on opponent's response.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's 6: Arcanine (Intimidate/Sitrus/Calm, Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect), Mawile (Intimidate/Passho/Impish, BrickBreak/IronHead/PlayRough/Protect), Empoleon (Competitive/Chople/Calm, FlashCannon/IceBeam/Surf/Protect), Grimmsnarl (Prankster/LightClay/Impish, LightScreen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect), Slowbro (Regenerator/Leftovers/Bold), Garchomp (RoughSkin/ExpertBelt/Jolly). Game 2: Dragapult Infiltrator bypasses screens. Prankster fails vs Dark-types (Incineroar immune to Prankster Taunt). Beware Empoleon Competitive punishing Incineroar Intimidate. Kingambit Defiant converts Intimidate into attack boosts. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice is key special offense.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Arcanine)
decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl uses Light Screen (Prankster +1) to cut Dragapult's special damage; Arcanine Snarls both foes, 2x on Dragapult while dropping its SpA. Incineroar's Fake Out can flinch only one of us, so we bank either a screen or a Snarl. No KO threat at full HP.
decisions.notebook: Opp G1 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Serperior (no Mega; Gardevoir/Samurott unseen). Tendencies: leads Incineroar + pivot (Dragapult U-turn or Kingambit Defiant); Incineroar pressures Fire-weak; Serperior Contrary LeafStorm +2 SpA threatens Empoleon; Kingambit Defiant triggers on Snarl/Intimidate. G2 plan: lead Arcanine+Grimmsnarl (Intimidate + Prankster screens) vs Incineroar/Dragapult; keep Empoleon (Ice Beam 2x, Grass resist) to switch on Serperior; Mawile as wall vs Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega, avoid as Incineroar target; preserve Grimmsnarl for expected Mega Gardevoir/Samurott.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Ball into Arcanine (30.5-57.6%, can't KO from 62% but triggers Sitrus Berry) while Parting Shot debuffs Arcanine to -2 Atk/-1 SpA and pivots Incineroar to Kingambit. Dragapult outspeeds Arcanine so Shadow Ball lands before any Snarl; Infiltrator ignores Grimmsnarl's likely Light Screen. Kingambit + Dragapult is a strong offensive core with Defiant deterring further Intimidate.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's 6: Arcanine (Intimidate/Sitrus/Calm, Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect), Mawile (Intimidate/Passho/Impish, BrickBreak/IronHead/PlayRough/Protect), Empoleon (Competitive/Chople/Calm, FlashCannon/IceBeam/Surf/Protect), Grimmsnarl (Prankster/LightClay/Impish, LightScreen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect), Slowbro (Regenerator/Leftovers/Bold), Garchomp (RoughSkin/ExpertBelt/Jolly). Game 2: Dragapult Infiltrator bypasses screens. Prankster fails vs Dark-types. Beware Empoleon Competitive punishing Intimidate/PartingShot. Kingambit Defiant converts stat drops into Atk boosts. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice is key special offense. Opponent's backline unrevealed this game; 2 of {Mawile,Empoleon,Slowbro,Garchomp} remain.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit switch: Dark-type immune to Prankster, Defiant punishes Snarl (+2 Atk from negligible 2-6% damage), physical Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head bypass Light Screen, Iron Head threatens Grimmsnarl (59-139%). Dragapult stays: Infiltrator ignores screens, survives any single Arcanine hit (Flamethrower 12-19%, Snarl 15-23%), can U-turn later to reset SpA drops.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent's 6 are Arcanine/Grimmsnarl + 2 of {Mawile,Empoleon,Slowbro,Garchomp}. Arcanine is special (Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect, Sitrus consumed). Grimmsnarl has no attacks (LightScreen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect, LightClay). Prankster fails vs Dark-types. Kingambit Defiant converts stat drops into Atk boosts. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice is key special offense but hindered by Light Screen. Dragapult Infiltrator bypasses screens. Empoleon Competitive punishes Intimidate/PartingShot. Garchomp RoughSkin+ExpertBelt threatens physical attackers.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Arcanine)
decisions.rationale: Snarl is 2x into Dragapult (Flamethrower only 0.5x), chips it and drops both foes' SpA further. Grimmsnarl's Prankster Light Screen halves Dragapult's special hits on both my mons; Arcanine's Sitrus cushions any remainder. No KO threat to either of my mons this turn, so set durable defense while applying pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opp G1 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Serperior (no Mega; Gardevoir/Samurott unseen). G2 lead again Incineroar+Dragapult (consistent). Tendencies: leads Incineroar + pivot (Dragapult U-turn or Kingambit Defiant); Incineroar pressures Fire-weak; Serperior Contrary LeafStorm +2 SpA threatens Empoleon; Kingambit Defiant triggers on Snarl/Intimidate. Matchup notes: Arcanine Snarl 2x into Dragapult (Dark vs Ghost); Flamethrower only 0.5x into Dragapult (Fire vs Dragon 0.5x) so Snarl > Flamethrower there; Shadow Ball 0.5x into Grimmsnarl (Ghost vs Dark). Arcanine Sitrus cushions special hits. G2 plan: lead Arcanine+Grimmsnarl (Intimidate + Prankster screens) vs Incineroar/Dragapult; keep Empoleon (Ice Beam 2x, Grass resist) to switch on Serperior; Mawile as wall vs Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega, avoid as Incineroar target; preserve Grimmsnarl for expected Mega Gardevoir/Samurott.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Ball (23.9-43%) + Kowtow Cleave (45.7-85.5%) = minimum 69.6% > Arcanine's 49%, guaranteed KO barring Protect. Dragapult outspeeds Arcanine and lands first; Kingambit moves after Grimmsnarl's Reflect and Arcanine's attack but secures the KO. Removing Arcanine eliminates the foe's only active damage dealer; Grimmsnarl is harmless alone. Dragapult takes Life Orb recoil to ~22% but survives Snarl if Arcanine uses it.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent's 6 are Arcanine/Grimmsnarl + 2 of {Mawile,Empoleon,Slowbro,Garchomp}. Arcanine special (Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect, Sitrus consumed, Intimidate). Grimmsnarl screens+Taunt (LightClay, Prankster, no attacks). Prankster fails vs Dark-types. Kingambit Defiant converts stat drops into Atk boosts. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice key special offense; Infiltrator Dragapult bypasses screens. Empoleon Competitive punishes Intimidate. Garchomp RoughSkin+ExpertBelt threatens physical attackers. Reflect in doubles is 0.66x reduction. Turn 3 plan: double-target Arcanine for guaranteed KO.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine cannot KO 31% Dragapult (Snarl max ~22%), and Snarl would trigger Kingambit Defiant. Protect guarantees Arcanine survives Shadow Ball + Sucker Punch. Grimmsnarl sets Reflect to complete screens vs Kingambit's physical hits (Light Screen already covers Dragapult's special). Safe, sets up turn 4 offense.
decisions.notebook: Opp G1 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Serperior (no Mega; Gardevoir/Samurott unseen). G2 lead again Incineroar+Dragapult (consistent); Kingambit entered turn 2 via Parting Shot pivot. Tendencies: leads Incineroar + pivot (Dragapult U-turn or Kingambit Defiant); Incineroar pressures Fire-weak; Serperior Contrary LeafStorm +2 SpA threatens Empoleon; Kingambit Defiant triggers on Snarl/Intimidate — avoid Snarl while Kingambit present. Matchup: Arcanine Snarl 2x Dragapult but triggers Defiant; Flamethrower 0.5x Dragapult / 2x Kingambit (no stat drop, prefer vs Kingambit); Shadow Ball 0.5x Grimmsnarl; Draco Meteor 0x Grimmsnarl (Fairy immune). Plan: keep Empoleon (Ice Beam 2x, Grass resist) for Serperior; Mawile walls Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega; preserve Grimmsnarl for expected Mega Gardevoir/Samurott. Dragapult cannot be KO'd by Arcanine in one hit.

decisions.rationale: Switch Dragapult to Gardevoir, which Mega Evolves (Speed ~166, outspeeding Arcanine's 147 max) and fires Pixilate Hyper Voice before opponents act. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave targets Arcanine. Hyper Voice heavily damages Grimmsnarl (39.6-106.5%) and chips Arcanine (8.6-23.6%); combined with Kowtow Cleave (30.5-57%) this KOs Arcanine. If Arcanine Snarls, Kingambit's Defiant gives +2 Atk for a guaranteed KO. Gardevoir-Mega takes minimal damage from both Flamethrower and Snarl. Dragapult is preserved at low HP.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent 6: Arcanine/Grimmsnarl + 2 of {Mawile,Empoleon,Slowbro,Garchomp}. Arcanine special (Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect, Sitrus consumed, Intimidate, Calm). Grimmsnarl screens+Taunt (LightClay, Prankster, no attacks). Prankster fails vs Dark-types. Kingambit Defiant converts stat drops into Atk boosts. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice key special offense; Mega Speed ~166 outspeeds Arcanine. Infiltrator Dragapult bypasses screens. Reflect in doubles is 0.66x. Empoleon Competitive punishes Intimidate. Garchomp RoughSkin+ExpertBelt. Turn 4: switching Dragapult to Gardevoir-Mega for immediate Hyper Voice pressure.

decisions.rationale: Snarl can't KO Dragapult (9-22% vs 31%) yet triggers Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk, which can KO either mon through screens) and self-hits Grimmsnarl. Flamethrower 2x into Kingambit is reliable (27-59%, no Defiant). Grimmsnarl Protects: Prankster Taunt is blocked by Dark-type Kingambit, screens already up, and Iron Head's upper range can KO Grimmsnarl. Leverages our screens safely.
decisions.notebook: Opp G1 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Serperior (no Mega). G2 lead Incineroar+Dragapult; Kingambit entered turn 2 via Parting Shot pivot. Opp 4th this game is exactly one of Gardevoir/Serperior/Samurott. Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk per stat drop) lets it KO Arcanine (Kowtow Cleave) or Grimmsnarl (Iron Head) through screens once triggered — NEVER Snarl or switch an Intimidate mon (Mawile) in while Kingambit is active. Dragapult at 31% SpA-2 cannot be KO'd by Arcanine (Snarl 9-22%, Flamethrower 0.5x); only wears via burn or a wall. Prankster status is blocked by Dark-type foes, so Grimmsnarl Taunt fails on Kingambit. Plan: keep Empoleon for Serperior (Grass 0.25x), Mawile walls Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega but avoid its Intimidate vs Kingambit, preserve Grimmsnarl for expected Mega Gardevoir/Samurott. Light Clay extends screens to 8 turns.

decisions.rationale: Mega Gardevoir Hyper Voice (Pixilate Fairy spread) + Kingambit Iron Head into Grimmsnarl. Combined min damage 98% > 93% HP, guaranteed KO on Grimmsnarl if both land, removing Light Clay screens. Arcanine at 10% is crippled; it may Protect or burn Kingambit but we have special backups (Dragapult/Mega Gardevoir). Removing screens now is worth the risk.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent 6: Arcanine/Grimmsnarl + 2 of {Mawile,Empoleon,Slowbro,Garchomp}. Arcanine special (Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect, Sitrus consumed, Intimidate, Calm). Grimmsnarl dual screens+Taunt (LightClay, Prankster, no attacks). Prankster fails vs Dark-types. Kingambit Defiant punishes stat drops. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice key special offense; Mega SpA ~215 Spe ~167. Infiltrator Dragapult bypasses screens. Empoleon Competitive punishes Intimidate. Garchomp RoughSkin+ExpertBelt. Turn 5: targeting Grimmsnarl to remove screens. If Arcanine burns Kingambit, fall back on special attackers.

decisions.rationale: Switch Arcanine to Empoleon to deny Kingambit a KO on the doomed 11% mon, preserve 4 mons, and bring a body that hits Gardevoir super effectively (Flash Cannon 2x). Gardevoir's Intimidate already fired so no Competitive, but Reflect/Light Screen mitigate Kingambit and Mega Gardevoir. Grimmsnarl Taunts Gardevoir to block Will-O-Wisp/Protect; Taunt fails on Dark Kingambit. Avoid triggering Defiant.
decisions.notebook: Opp G2 team confirmed: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Gardevoir (Serperior & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought). Gardevoir holds Gardevoirite (Mega -> Pixilate, 165 SpA). Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk per stat drop): NEVER Snarl it or switch an Intimidate mon (Mawile) in while active, or it KOs through screens. Prankster status blocked by Dark foes (Taunt fails on Kingambit). Dragapult 31% cannot be KO'd by Arcanine (Snarl 9-22%, Flamethrower 0.5x); wears via burn/wall only. Light Clay extends screens to 8 turns. Empoleon's Competitive needs a fresh Intimidate (Incineroar) or stat drop to trigger; Gardevoir's Intimidate already fired, so switching Empoleon in now grants no buff. Mawile walls Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega but its Intimidate feeds Kingambit's Defiant.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl fainted; slot b must be refilled. Arcanine (11%) would trigger Kingambit's Defiant then die. Mawile (100%) walls both foes: resists Gardevoir-Mega's Pixilate Hyper Voice/Psychic (Fairy/Psychic 0.5x via Steel) and all Kingambit moves (Dark 0.5x, Steel neutral); survives Kowtow Cleave 17-59% and Hyper Voice 21-76%. Empoleon has only Pass/Forfeit and stays safe behind screens (Reflect halves Kingambit). Never forfeit at 0-1.
decisions.notebook: Opp G2 team confirmed: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Gardevoir (Serperior & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought). Gardevoir holds Gardevoirite (Mega -> Pixilate; Hyper Voice becomes Fairy, 165 SpA). Steel resists Fairy/Psychic, so Empoleon/Mawile wall it. Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk per stat drop): NEVER Snarl it or switch an Intimidate mon (Mawile/Arcanine) in while active, or it KOs through screens. Prankster status blocked by Dark foes (Taunt fails on Kingambit). Dragapult 31% cannot be KO'd by Arcanine (Snarl 9-22%, Flamethrower 0.5x); wears via burn/wall only. Light Clay extends screens to 8 turns. Empoleon's Competitive needs a fresh Intimidate (Incineroar) or stat drop to trigger; Gardevoir's Intimidate already fired, so switching Empoleon in now grants no buff. Mawile walls Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega (resists all their moves); Passho Berry.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir is Taunted with both STABs resisted into both foes and cannot Protect. Switching it to Incineroar preserves it for later while Intimidate weakens Mawile. Kingambit Protects to block the likely Brick Break OHKO. Competitive triggers on Empoleon but Incineroar resists Flash Cannon (18-42%) and has Sitrus Berry. Next turn Fake Out + Kowtow Cleave threatens Empoleon.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent 6: Arcanine/Grimmsnarl + 2 of {Mawile,Empoleon,Slowbro,Garchomp}. Arcanine special (Snarl/Flamethrower/WillOWisp/Protect, Sitrus consumed, Intimidate, Calm). Grimmsnarl dual screens+Taunt (LightClay, Prankster, no attacks). Prankster fails vs Dark-types. Kingambit Defiant punishes stat drops. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice key special offense; Mega SpA ~215 Spe ~167. Infiltrator Dragapult bypasses screens. Empoleon Competitive punishes Intimidate. Garchomp RoughSkin+ExpertBelt. Turn 5: targeted Grimmsnarl to remove screens. If Arcanine burns Kingambit, fall back on special attackers. Game 2 turn 6 plan: switch Gardevoir to Incineroar, Kingambit Protect; turn 7 Fake Out Empoleon + Kowtow Cleave.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir-Mega is Taunted and cannot Protect, so both hits on it are guaranteed: Flash Cannon (2x, 37.7-64.3%) + Iron Head (2x, 48-93.7%) combine for ~86-158% and reliably KO it, forcing a bench send. Kingambit can simply Protect to nullify Brick Break and is walled by Mawile anyway, so splitting risks wasting Mawile. Both our Steel-types resist all foe attacks (0.5x + screens), keeping us safe while grinding the special threat down.
decisions.notebook: Opp G2/G3 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Gardevoir (Serperior & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought). Gardevoir = Gardevoirite (Mega->Pixilate; Hyper Voice becomes Fairy). Steel (Empoleon/Mawile) resists Fairy/Psychic, walls it. Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk per stat drop): NEVER Snarl or switch Intimidate mon (Mawile/Arcanine) in vs it. Prankster status blocked by Dark (Taunt fails on Kingambit). Dragapult 31% can't be KO'd by Arcanine; wears via wall/burn. Light Clay -> screens 8 turns. Empoleon Competitive needs fresh Intimidate (Incineroar) or drop. Mawile walls Dragapult/Kingambit/Gardevoir-Mega (resists all). KEY: Taunted Gardevoir-Mega cannot Protect, must Hyper Voice/Psychic (both 0.5x into Steel, safe). Double-target it with Flash Cannon + Iron Head (2x each) to force KO since it can't Protect; Kingambit will likely Protect a 4x Brick Break, so don't rely on it. After Gardevoir falls, remaining foes are physical (Mawile walls).

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 priority) flinches Empoleon, preventing its +2 Surf that OHKO-rolls Incineroar (69-103%) and threatens Kingambit (47-70%). Kowtow Cleave into Empoleon (66.5-121.4%) has a solid OHKO chance despite Chople Berry. Mawile's Brick Break into Kingambit (30-46%) leaves it alive. If Empoleon Protects, both moves are blocked but Incineroar is safe and Kingambit only takes 30-46%. Best worst-case.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent revealed Arcanine (special, Sitrus consumed, Intimidate), Grimmsnarl (dual screens+Taunt, LightClay, Prankster, fainted), Empoleon (Competitive, ChopleBerry, Calm, Surf/FlashCannon/IceBeam/Protect), Mawile (Intimidate, PasshoBerry, Impish, BrickBreak/IronHead/PlayRough/Protect). Garchomp and Slowbro not brought. Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate for free +2. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice is special offense but weak into dual Steel types under Light Screen. Infiltrator Dragapult bypasses screens for late-game cleanup. Opponent relies on screens + Intimidate for bulk. Remove Grimmsnarl early to deny screen reset.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar can't be KO'd by combined single-target hits (max ~60%<64%) and its Flare Blitz can OHKO Mawile (up to 106%), our key wall vs Gardevoir-Mega/Dragapult. Mawile Protects (priority +4) to guarantee survival; Empoleon Surf (SpA+2) likely OHKOs Incineroar (63-139% vs 64% HP) and chips Kingambit (32-72%). Screens keep Empoleon safe from any retaliation (Flare Blitz 24-50%, Sucker Punch 16-33%).
decisions.notebook: Opp G2/G3 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Gardevoir (Serperior & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought). Gardevoir = Gardevoirite (Mega->Pixilate; Hyper Voice becomes Fairy). Steel (Empoleon/Mawile) resists Fairy/Psychic, walls it; Mawile immune to Dragon. Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk per stat drop): NEVER Snarl or switch Intimidate mon (Mawile/Arcanine) in vs it. Prankster status blocked by Dark (Taunt fails on Kingambit). Dragapult 31% can't be KO'd by Arcanine; wears via wall/burn. Light Clay -> screens 8 turns. Empoleon Competitive needs fresh Intimidate (Incineroar) or drop; with SpA+2, Surf (2x into Fire/Incineroar) is a likely KO and also chips Kingambit, while Flash Cannon/Ice Beam are only 0.5x. Mawile walls Gardevoir-Mega/Dragapult; keep it alive (Incineroar FlareBlitz can OHKO it). KEY: Taunted Gardevoir-Mega cannot Protect, must Hyper Voice/Psychic (both 0.5x into Steel, safe). Double-target it with Flash Cannon + Iron Head (2x each) to force KO since it can't Protect; Kingambit will likely Protect a 4x Brick Break, so don't rely on it. After Gardevoir falls, remaining foes are physical (Mawile walls).

decisions.rationale: Parting Shot into Mawile lowers its Atk to -2, neutering its Brick Break threat to Kingambit. Kingambit Protects to avoid the potential Surf+BrickBreak double-target KO. Switch to Gardevoir-Mega at full HP, which handles Mawile well and sets up a 2v2 with screens fading soon. This preserves both mons while safely repositioning.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent Arcanine (special, Sitrus consumed), Grimmsnarl (dual screens+Taunt, LightClay, Prankster, fainted), Empoleon (Competitive, ChopleBerry, Calm, Surf/FlashCannon/IceBeam/Protect), Mawile (Intimidate, PasshoBerry, Impish, BrickBreak/IronHead/PlayRough/Protect). Garchomp/Slowbro not brought. Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice weak into dual Steel under Light Screen. Infiltrator Dragapult bypasses screens for cleanup. Parting Shot into Empoleon triggers Competitive — avoid. Mawile's Brick Break is 4x into Kingambit — neutralize with attack drops. Screens: Light Screen 2t, Reflect 3t remaining after turn 8. Arcanine at 10% on bench is minimal threat.

decisions.rationale: Switch Incineroar to Gardevoir-Mega. Gardevoir's Intimidate drops Mawile to -3 Atk and Empoleon to -2 Atk, neutering Brick Break (now 16-32% into Kingambit). Gardevoir at full HP can tank hits and Will-O-Wisp Mawile next turn. Dragapult at 32% with Life Orb is too fragile. Kingambit stays in and can KO Empoleon (27%) with Kowtow Cleave next turn. Taunt has worn off by turn 9.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent Arcanine (special, Sitrus consumed, 10%), Grimmsnarl (fainted), Empoleon (Competitive, ChopleBerry, Calm, 27%, +2 SpA), Mawile (Intimidate, PasshoBerry, Impish, -2 Atk/-1 SpA). Screens: Light Screen 2t, Reflect 3t remaining. Gardevoir-Mega switch brings Intimidate to further cripple Mawile. Avoid Parting Shot into Empoleon (Competitive). Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate. Dragapult Infiltrator bypasses screens for cleanup but fragile at low HP.

decisions.rationale: Empoleon's only KO is Surf (2x Incineroar) but it self-KOs adjacent Mawile (~153) and Kingambit (Spd>80) likely outspeeds to KO Empoleon first. Protect (fresh, 100%) guarantees Empoleon survives Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave. Mawile Brick Break 4x into Kingambit chips the Empoleon-killer without feeding Incineroar's Sitrus; Reflect keeps Mawile alive vs FlareBlitz.
decisions.notebook: Opp G2/G3 team: Incineroar, Dragapult, Kingambit, Gardevoir (Serperior & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought). Gardevoir=Gardevoirite (Mega->Pixilate; Hyper Voice Fairy). Steel (Empoleon/Mawile) resists Fairy/Psychic, walls it; Mawile immune to Dragon. Kingambit Defiant (+2 Atk/drop): never Snarl or switch Intimidate mon vs it. Prankster status blocked by Dark (Taunt fails on Kingambit). Dragapult 31% can't be KO'd by Arcanine. Light Clay -> screens 8 turns. Empoleon Competitive needs fresh Intimidate (Incineroar) or drops; SpA+2 Surf 2x KOs Incineroar but Surf also hits adjacent ally (self-KO Mawile) - never Surf with Mawile adjacent. Flash Cannon/Ice Beam only 0.5x into Incineroar/Kingambit. Kingambit (Spd ~80-102) outspeeds Empoleon (80): Empoleon must Protect vs Kingambit Kowtow Cleave (KOs 28% Empoleon). Mawile walls Gardevoir-Mega/Dragapult; keep alive (Incineroar FlareBlitz 2x, but Reflect halves). Taunted Gardevoir-Mega can't Protect -> double Flash Cannon+Iron Head. After Gardevoir falls, foes physical (Mawile walls).

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch (+1 priority) KOs Empoleon before it moves if it attacks (36.6% min > 27% HP). Hyper Voice chips Mawile through Light Screen. If Empoleon Protects (reduced 33% success), Hyper Voice still leaves it near-dead and Light Screen expires next turn. Gardevoir avoids Flash Cannon OHKO threat by eliminating Empoleon first.

reflections.summary: Our team was perfectly built to dismantle the opponent's Intimidate + screens + Competitive Empoleon strategy. Kingambit's Defiant turned their double Intimidate into a +2 Attack boost, Dragapult's Infiltrator ignored screens to pressure Arcanine and Grimmsnarl, and Mega Gardevoir's spread Hyper Voice stalled out the screens before cleaning. Incineroar's Fake Out and Parting Shot disrupted their lead, and we played carefully around Empoleon's Competitive, allowing us to sweep after screen expiration. The 2‑0 series win reflects superior prep and matchup exploitation.
reflections.adjustment: No major changes needed; our anti‑Intimidate core (Kingambit + Dragapult + Mega Gardevoir) hard‑countered their team. In a future series, I would keep the same four but may experiment with Hisuian Samurott over Incineroar to pressure Empoleon without triggering Competitive, though Incineroar's Fake Out and pivoting were valuable. I must be more conservative with Parting Shot and Intimidate around Empoleon; in Game 2 the accidental Competitive boost could have been costly against a different board state.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's core tendencies: Intimidate stacking (Arcanine, Mawile) with Light Clay Grimmsnarl dual screens to enable a late‑game sweeper (Empoleon Competitive). Grimmsnarl leads often; they Protect aggressively to waste screen turns. Arcanine is special (Snarl, Will‑O‑Wisp, Flamethrower, Sitrus). Mawile is physical (Brick Break for screen counterplay, Passho Berry for Water coverage). Empoleon carries Chople Berry and waits for Competitive boosts. Slowbro (Regenerator, Leftovers) and Garchomp (Expert Belt?) not seen but likely physically defensive and fast physical, respectively. Durable prep takeaways: Infiltrator Dragapult (Life Orb, Timid) is mandatory to ignore screens and beat Arcanine/Grimmsnarl. Defiant Kingambit (BlackGlasses, Adamant) punishes their Intimidate turns and pressures Empoleon with Dark moves. Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice wins after screen expiration; keep it healthy. Incineroar's Fake Out disrupts Grimmsnarl lead, but avoid using Parting Shot or switching it in when Empoleon is on field. Consider Will‑O‑Wisp on Gardevoir for Garchomp/Mawile. Hisuian Samurott (Sharpness, Ceaseless Edge) could be an alternative Empoleon answer that doesn't lower stats, but would require testing.

reflections.summary: Series lost 0-2. In game 2 we adjusted by bringing Empoleon+Mawile Steel core with Arcanine/Grimmsnarl support to wall opponent's Mega Gardevoir and Dragapult, but this backfired: Mawile's Intimidate triggered Kingambit's Defiant (+2 Atk), and the Steel pair were ground down by Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice and Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave/Sucker Punch while Arcanine was flinched by Fake Out and screens faded. No Mega evolution on our side left us short on firepower. Opponent's Incineroar/Kingambit/Gardevoir synergy exploited our overlapping Intimidate and lack of Fairy/Dark offense.
reflections.adjustment: Against this opponent, do not bring Mawile with Intimidate into Kingambit; either Mega-evolve Mawile (Huge Power) or replace it with Slowbro or Garchomp from bench. Register Mega Gengar or Alakazam for Ghost/Psychic pressure on Gardevoir. Avoid Snarl/Intimidate drops on Kingambit. Consider leading a prankster Taunt to block Fake Out, and give Empoleon a stronger STAB or ally to break Gardevoir. Bring a Fairy/Dark resist that isn't hurt by own Intimidate.
reflections.notebook: Opp core: Incineroar (Intimidate/Parting Shot/Fake Out), Dragapult (Infiltrator LifeOrb), Kingambit (Defiant, punishes Atk drops), Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate Hyper Voice). Serperior/Samurott-Hisui unseen in G2 but possible. Strategic facts: Kingambit Defiant turns Intimidate/Snarl into +2 Atk; Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice (Fairy) resisted by Steel but chips; Incineroar FlareBlitz 2x vs Steel. Prep conclusions: Steel wall plan partially right but Mawile Intimidate self-sabotage; Empoleon Competitive needs fresh Intimidate but still can't reliably KO Gardevoir; no Mega on our side disadvantaged; left-behind Mega Gengar/Alakazam would threaten Gardevoir; Slowbro could special-wall; avoid overlapping Intimidate vs Defiant.
